pages.title: Acheronite Armor
pages.text: $(bold)Orbital Scan #0079$()$(li)Netherite-tier defense and toughness$(li)$(bold)Frostbite immunity$(): carry shards freely

pages.title: Limits
pages.text: $(danger)No atmospheric protection.$() Only the $(l:orsa_equipment/eva_suit)EVA Suit$(/l) keeps you breathing.$(br2)$(flavor)Looking cool does not prevent suffocation.$()

pages.title: Acheronite Chestplate
pages.text: $(flavor)The ingots are cold. The chestplate is warm. Science is weird.$()

pages.title: Acheronite Helmet
pages.text: $(flavor)Protects your head and your dignity. At least one of those matters.$()

pages.title: Acheronite Leggings
pages.text: $(flavor)Your legs called. They want to stop being frozen.$()

pages.title: Acheronite Boots
pages.text: $(flavor)Walk on frozen everything without losing toes.$()
